editorial.blurb: The Welcome Back Lounge is a lively Logan Square spot where great drinks and solid food meet an energetic community vibe, anchored by regular karaoke nights and surprise midnight hot dogs.
editorial.insiderTip: Show up on Sunday at 9 p.m. for karaoke and ask for Chance the Bartender—the community here is genuinely welcoming and the energy is unbeatable. Or catch Monday bingo. Pro tip: order via the QR code on tables for seamless service.
